headline: The WATCH cannon learns to take the shot it has
lede: Batch 20 gave Space Invaders' autopilot two arcade habits: fire the moment anything is lined up, and lead the march through the wall bounce. Every seeded flight clears wave 1 about 30% faster — and Defender's far-side problem got an honest verdict instead of a fake fix.

notes.text: Re-aim: the Y brain used to march to the lowest invader's column while another sat aligned under its nose (~500 green-gate ticks per seed ignored). Now the aligned shot leaves the tick it appears.

Edge-bounce fold: straight leads were fiction once the column reversed mid-flight. The meeting point now predicts the bounce — slowest clean clear 1857 -> 1265 ticks, worst stall 172, pins tightened and every one proven red on deletion.

Defender far-side haul interception measured three ways; every variant raised patrol totals but regressed a seed floor (7800 -> 3150-5850). At 4000 px the far side is outside the rescue window — the gap stays honest, now with the dead ends written down.
Judge Defender brains by the seed floor, waves-cleared count, and deaths — total score lies. A new fort-preservation pin caught the mutant that the speedups would otherwise have orphaned.
